standard_observations: CSID680 RDI BUF_DONE IRQ -> camss_buf_done -> VFE owner completion routing exists and is source/model-qualified; VFE680 no-op ISR is not itself a missing completion path
VFE680 global_reset completes a software completion immediately, without issuing a hardware reset
VFE680 output_stop writes its RDI WM CFG zero; generic vfe_disable_output then accepts the software reset completion and releases output ownership
CSID680 configure_stream(false) writes halt-at-frame-boundary without waiting for hardware stop or draining the actual completion IRQ
source28/30/31 owns and preserves DMA/PM on explicit failure, but cannot detect a hardware teardown failure hidden by successful void/no-op callbacks
source08 reset freshness covers power-up only and rejects active streams; it cannot be relabeled as stream DMA retirement

rear59 exact ten-WM consumed-IOVA ledger and source-before-drain semantics have genuine hardware proof in their own PIX/rear domain; front single RDI API and WM24+ mapping need a minimal port and separate qualification
reuse_decision: Reuse matching native RDI graph/capture format, existing owned-stage fault quarantine, native reset/drain/BUS readback helpers and latest59 source-stop-before-drain policy. Port only API, exclusive-owner and one-RDI-WM gaps. No repeated Windows reverse engineering or copied startup blobs required.
compatibility_gaps: Typed error-returning stream-stop/quiesce hooks in CSID/VFE standard callbacks
Stop producer before strict drain where required; preserve separate acquired-stage start unwind and fault pinning
CSID fresh reset acknowledgement, all relevant IRQ masks/status clear and real IRQ synchronization under one exclusive image owner
VFE zero-CFG/mask readback and IRQ barrier for only owned RDI WM; execute sleeping IRQ barriers outside output spinlock
Prevent normal VB2 flush/free and PM release until all stop predicates hold, including late completion concurrency
Demonstrate new normal stop/reopen plus partial-start/fault quarantine without treating old native proofs as new7.2 hardware results
